label: Preservation capture: public postings of Metaconceptual Art (2011-2012)
note: Local copies of two Pastebin postings that carry Metaconceptual Art before 2013. These files are a preservation copy, not the dated source. The evidential weight of the dates rests on Pastebin's own records, which assign a posting timestamp the poster cannot alter; a local file proves only what was retrieved and when. The copies exist because every other source that once carried this material has been lost, and the postings themselves sit on a platform the studio does not control. Verify against the live URLs while they remain available.

items.title: MetaConceptual Art
items.carries: The 8 Defining characteristics of Metaconceptual Art, agreeing word for word with the published Eight Sentences apart from a comma, a space, and the spelling 'Transcendance'.
